note: Every rule id below is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py RULES and vice versa; extraction/verify_all.py fails on any mismatch. Each rule was checked against templates.json template.home at write time.

rules.rule: PageSpec validates against schema/pagespec.schema.json (draft-07).
spec.template exists in templates.json and spec.route is one of that template's routes.
nodes[] must match the declared template's own node list: every required node present, order preserved, non-repeatable not duplicated, no sections outside the template.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: template.home 9 nodes, all required, none repeatable -> ok

rules.rule: Sections with constraints.onePerPage appear at most once, keyed on (section, variant).
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: all 9 sections onePerPage; template.home has each once -> ok

rules.rule: chrome.floating-nav is node 0.
chrome.footer is the last node.
Exactly one primary hero (hero.intro). hero.demo-mockup shares the 'hero' category (ia.json) but is the demo companion, not a second hero: it is allowed only directly after hero.intro.

exceptions.reason: ia.json files the demo under HERO; it is the hero's demo companion (same header[data-bookmark]), not a competing hero.

rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: template.home has hero.intro once, hero.demo-mockup at [2] right after it -> ok
rules.exceptionNote: No hero-less template exists (single template); add a named exception here AND in semantic_validate.NO_HERO_TEMPLATES if one is ever added.

rules.rule: hero.intro, hero.demo-mockup, story.why-funnel appear consecutively in that order right after chrome.floating-nav: they share one header[data-bookmark] clip-path and the tag floor follows its bottom edge.
story.finding immediately follows story.why-funnel: its gradient line grows from the bookmark tip (CLONE_SPEC.md:420).
conversion.closing-waitlist immediately precedes chrome.footer (footer sits directly under the green block, CLONE_SPEC.md:539).
Every chrome.floating-nav link anchor (#id) matches the anchorId of a section present in the spec.
The nav CTA href #waitlist resolves to hero.intro (anchorId 'waitlist'); the closing waitlist has no id.
Two adjacent nodes should not share a category.

exceptions.reason: Both HERO in ia.json; real adjacency: the demo sits directly under the hero text inside the same header (CLONE_SPEC.md:102-103).
Both STORY; real adjacency: the finding line grows from the bookmark tip (CLONE_SPEC.md:420).
Both STORY; real adjacency: 'find' then 'save' are the two halves of the product story; finding sits on the page surface, saving on a raised squircle card.

rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: template.home has 3 same-category adjacencies (hero->hero, story->story x2): all covered by named exceptions

rules.rule: Every node's motion carries reducedMotionFallback (the site honours prefers-reduced-motion: animations none / transitions 0s).
Each node's motion.pattern / secondary / reducedMotionFallback equals its section contract's (const-locked); signature motion must not silently degrade to a generic fade.
Every text field respects its x-maxWords budget (per instance, resolved through $ref).
Every colorToken in the spec exists in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and is not restricted.

Every waitlist form's endpointPolicy equals the pinned value of its endpointRole in assets/asset-roles.json (form.waitlist-endpoint -> must-not-reuse-live-endpoint). Membership in the policy enum alone is not sufficient (MASTER-GUIDE 3.23).
When purpose == 'generated', no assetRole/iconRole/tapMarkRole may reference a role pinned to must-not-reproduce-real-brand (Shelf logo, app icons, third-party brand icons).
When purpose == 'generated', copy should not contain the real company's name/domain ('Shelf', 'savetoshelf').
